I don't have information on free-shipping thresholds or shipping rates for standard orders, so I can't confirm whether your $78 order qualifies. The shipping cost shown at checkout or on your order confirmation is the best guide.

The one free-shipping rule I can confirm is for Leafy Plus members ($59/year), who get free Standard shipping with no minimum. Express isn't included.

If you'd like a definite answer about your order, I can escalate it to a Support Lead. Do you have your order number (LF- plus six digits)?
